$comment: The Forma vocabulary that dist/echelon-app.css and dist/echelon-fonts.css may USE. These files define nothing in Forma's namespace: a .forma-* class, data-forma-* attribute or --forma-* property they mention must be listed here, and every entry here must exist in Forma's own CSS (CI checks this list against the Forma release below with `tools/theme_validator.py --forma-css`). Declaring any --forma-* property is always rejected.
